cases.mutation: Use the VPG45 APPROVED row as the Production approval.
cases.required_invariant: The row explicitly forbids deployment, alias, and Production action.

cases.mutation: Supply a structurally valid approval object and recompute its caller-controlled SHA-256 digest.
cases.required_invariant: A self-hash is integrity metadata, not proof of durable Human Gate authority.

cases.mutation: Mark all missing Harvey paths authorized and the decision RESOLVED without a bound Human Gate decision.
cases.required_invariant: Caller-supplied authorized removals cannot establish disposition authority.

cases.mutation: Supply packet and receipt text carrying only the expected cycle ID and legacy label.
cases.required_invariant: Identity strings alone cannot establish the content or completion of release evidence.

cases.mutation: Supply PASS claims for alias, release integrity, cycle identity, J, and Harvey while withholding their raw bound evidence.
cases.required_invariant: Independent PASS receipts are evidence inputs, never composite release authority.

cases.mutation: Substitute the last real VPG41 J receipt and manifests for current-cycle J.
cases.required_invariant: J must bind the current release cycle, candidate, branch, exact remote ref, and evidence envelope.

cases.mutation: Change the execution branch after the approval and J evidence were created.
cases.required_invariant: Branch must equal every bound approval, J, candidate, and release field.

cases.mutation: Change HEAD or upstream while leaving candidate provenance and J unchanged.
cases.required_invariant: HEAD, upstream, candidate source, J product/closure, and remote branch must agree.

cases.mutation: Keep the candidate deployment ID but change its source commit.
cases.required_invariant: Candidate deployment and provenance must bind the exact approved commit.

cases.mutation: Swap current Production and rollback deployment identities.
cases.required_invariant: Current Production and rollback are distinct roles; rollback is recovery, not coexistence.

cases.mutation: Add, remove, or replace an alias after approval.
cases.required_invariant: Requested and applied aliases must exactly equal the approved canonical alias set.

cases.mutation: Reuse an otherwise valid approval from another cycle, candidate, rollback, or alias set.
cases.required_invariant: Production approval is single-scope and cannot be replayed across release identities.

cases.mutation: Leave the 37-path Harvey disposition unresolved or label rollback as coexistence.
cases.required_invariant: Harvey requires a bound eligible disposition; rollback alone is not coexistence.

cases.mutation: Use approval, J, guard, or release evidence not present in the immutable candidate custody.
cases.required_invariant: Release authority cannot depend on mutable dirty or untracked evidence.

cases.mutation: Change any branch, commit, deployment, alias, approval, J, or Harvey field after the evaluated evidence digest was produced.
cases.required_invariant: The pre-mutation caller must present the same canonical evidence digest the evaluator decided.
